scope: Matched stationary and moving phases; ordinary async MoveToPose/Home; unchanged V4 scene, camera geometry and diagnostic motion tolerances.

final_combined_gates_per_phase.movement_apply_p99_rule: At most twice the larger validated control-only phase p99, rounded to 0.0001 ms.

interpretation: These are workstation/workload acceptance gates derived from the validated control baseline and its zero severe pauses, not a universal simulator FPS target. Raw distributions, actual tracking errors, drops and source-age limits remain reported independently. No controller or perception algorithm is changed to satisfy these gates.
strategy_evaluation: Bounded threads improved control gaps but failed original freshness and throughput limits. The subprocess pilot passed those limits before the final four-mode sweep; final acceptance requires unchanged-source evidence and lifecycle/manipulation/regression validation.
